notes.title: Demo available during Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42335197/b74d55f23c5f3509f89e43afbeed7b1f474d4336.png[/img]

Hi, I'm a solo developer of roguelite racing game Near the Fear.

The theme of the game is battling your inner demons on a procedurally generated tracks set in a surreal world of subconscious. You can use light/dark abilities and your approach will reflect in changing the world around you.

Demo is now available during Steam Next Fest, enjoy!
